meta.description: The ORVIBO S1 2K Smart Camera watches over your home in sharp 2K, with AI person detection, motion tracking, cry detection, color night vision, two-way talk and a physical privacy shutter.
meta.spec.description: ORVIBO S1 2K Smart Camera (SC41PT) specifications: 2K resolution, 360° horizontal and 210° vertical field of view, night vision up to 10 m, 2.4/5 GHz Wi-Fi, microSD card up to 128 GB.
camera_banner.banner_desc: 2K ultra HD | AI person detection | Motion tracking | Cry detection
alt.awards: iF Design Award 2021 and Red Dot Award 2021
sec1.title: A big, clear eye · A new way of seeing
sec1.desc:
Free of convention and far from ordinary, with a big-eye look all its own.
Design and performance you'll love at first touch.
This is the S1 2K Smart Camera.
sec2.title: An original in tech and design, in an industry of copycats
sec3.title: Big-eye ultra HD, a flagship pan-tilt camera
sec3.desc:
Up to 3 megapixels for a 2K picture at maximum sharpness, with all-new imaging.
Less blur and lag, no lost details, and still sharp when you zoom in.
sec4.title: A smart AI eye that tells people from things, for precise alerts
sec4.desc:
It tells people apart from the objects in view, so it notices an intruder quickly
without being fooled by insects or a breeze moving things around.
sec4.content_desc: Alerts only when a person appears
sec4.item_desc:
Event: your pet runs around
Response: follows it and records the fun
sec4.item_desc2:
Event: an intruder
Response: follows, records and sends an alert
sec5.title: A wide view with no blind spots
sec5.desc: A wider viewing angle goes beyond what the pan-tilt head alone can turn: one full turn shows the whole home, missing nothing.
sec5.title2: Scheduled patrols to watch your home remotely
sec6.title: Night vision that turns night into day
sec6.desc:
In low light it switches to infrared night vision on its own, and its highly sensitive sensor
captures quality color pictures even at night or against the light.
sec6.video_desc: * In low light (above 0.3 lux), the picture stays in color
sec7.title: Smart cry detection for worry-free parenting
sec7.desc:
Get on with chores while the baby sleeps, without running back and forth to the nursery,
and still know how your little one is sleeping at any moment.
sec8.title: Sorted events, answers at a glance
sec8.desc: Events are sorted automatically, so every notification is clear at a glance. When you look back, you quickly find the scene you want, with nothing irrelevant in the way.
sec9.title: Two-way talk: see and chat
sec9.desc:
Two-way voice calls with clear picture and sound, free of noise. Missing home?
Just give it a “call” anytime.
sec10.title: Check in from your phone, anytime, anywhere
sec11.title: A one-tap physical shutter stops privacy leaks at the source
sec11.desc:
When you don't need the camera, put it to sleep with one tap on MixPad: the lens turns into the body,
and your private space stays private.
sec12.title: Connected smart security for the whole home
sec12.item_desc:
Several cameras, each in its spot,
guard every room
sec12.item_desc2:
Works with MixPad Elf:
turn the camera on or off by voice
sec12.item_desc3:
Teams up with the video doorbell:
inside and out, all in view
sec12.item_desc4:
The smart lock's Away mode:
surveillance starts as you leave
sec13.item_desc:
Dual-band 5 GHz/2.4 GHz Wi-Fi
use either, no network change
sec13.item_desc3:
Upright or upside down,
flip the picture in one tap
block.title: Specifications
block.v6: Infrared HD up to 10 m, full color in low light
block.v11: On a desk, mounted upright or upside down
block.v12: microSD card (up to 128 GB) and cloud
